preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdin.split())
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two integers u and v, each in the range [0, 10^18].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.count('\n') == 1 and all(int(x) > 0 for x in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, stdout is exactly '-1'. Otherwise, the first line is n (length of array), followed by n positive integers representing the array.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() != '-1') and (lambda arr: (sum(arr) == v) and (reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, arr, 0) == u))(list(map(int, stdout.split()[1:])) if '\n' in stdout else [])
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the array's sum equals v and its bitwise-xor equals u. For empty array (n=0), sum and xor are both 0.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() != '-1') and (lambda n: n == 0 or n == 1 or n == 2 or (n == 3 and u != 0 and v >= 3))(int(stdout.split()[0]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output array length n is either 0 (only when u=0 and v=0), 1 (only when u=0 and v>0), 2 (when u != 0 and v >= u), or 3 (when u != 0 and v < u and v >= 3).
